build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates a physics puzzle scene with standing sticks and balls
add_static_bar: create a static bar obstacle in the PHYRE scene with configurable scale and position
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball object to the PHYRE scene positioned relative to other bodies
update_task_relationships: define the PHYRE task goal by setting body relationships like TOUCHING between two objects
set_solution_tier: set the PHYRE task metadata to specify the TWO_BALLS solution tier for the puzzle
